lines.t: What is trust with abandonment When the heart still holds its breath
What is obedience without expectation A quiet vow, a step beyond regret
Is not your reasonable service Love without the need to earn
Still deeper yet the soul is learning What the faithful heart must discern
For I tell you the truth Trust is more than letting go
It stands in the fire It blooms in the storm shadow
Oh-oh-oh-oh-oh-oh
It lives in your obedience
It speaks through the things you do
When you bear his name in every season
That's the love that proves you true
Mm-mm-mm-mm-mm-mm-mm
Mm-mm-mm-mm-mm-mm-mm
When silence seems your answer
And hope feels far from your hand
Still walk the path of surrender
Though you may not understand
For faith is more than feeling
It's the courage to remain
To trust though tears are falling
To love through loss and pain
For I tell you the truth
Trust is more than letting go
It stands in the fire, it blooms in the storm shadow
It lives in your obedience, it speaks through the things you do
When you bear his name in every season
That's the love that proves you're true
Never deny his name
Though the night may test your flame
Through every time, through every season
Stand firm and believe again
For I tell you the truth
Trust is more than letting go
It walks beside obedience
It's to teach your soul, my soul
By your faith and by example
By the love that carries through
Every time and every season
That's how he's revealed in you
